rows.TEXT: This gate keeps the way to the Undead Hordes' territory and shall remain closed until the proper seal is broken
This gate leads to the Clans sacred lands and shall remain shut until the proper seal has been broken.
Until the proper seal has been broken, this gate that leads to the Damned will remain shut to you.
This gate leads to the Empire's land and it is only by breaking the proper seal that it can be entered.
The gate to the lands of the Clans has been opened!
The gate to the Empire is now opened!
The way to the lands of the Legions is now clear!
The gate to the land of the dead is now opened.
By Wotan, you won't pass here. You are not worthy to be allowed to go beyond this pass.
As your first test, you shall have to pass me. Only then will the way to salvation be opened to you.
This way is closed to you until you have proven yourself in battle against me.
This is what awaits you if you dare go any further
Now let us see how you will fare against my minions!
What will you do against my precious giants now?
The High Father now sends his Angels to further test your abilities
By Wotan, you will fight now!
The artifact you need to break the seal can be found in a tower not far from here. You must seek it and destroy its' guardians first.
There is an object that you will need to break the seal. To obtain it, you must destroy it's guardians in ancient Odense.
There is an abandonned temple further on your road. It is within it's walls that you will find the sacred object that is required to break the seal.
It is in the Gardens of Mortis that you will find the object that will allow you to break the seal. The guardians there must first be defeated for you to obtain it.
Now that you have the artifact, bring it to the gate, beyond the guardians. The seal will then be broken and you will be allowed to continue on your quest.
Now go beyond the giant guardian  with the eye. This will break the seal and open the gate that leads to the land beyond.
This is well done! Now take this dagger to the gate, beyond the guardian. This will break the seal and reveal a passage.
Now that you passed this stage, bring the vial to the gate. You will have to pass the guardian first and once you succeed, the seal will be finally broken.
To win this contest, you must take Gorgon Castle. Doing so will allow you to gain access to our enemies.
There is a castle beyond. You must take it to gain access to our enemies.
To the east lies Gorgon Castle. You must seize control of it to be allowed to enter ou enemies lands.
In this part of the land, there is a castle that you must take. Doing so will open the way to our enemies.
You are really the champion of the Empire! The High Father blesses you and your enemies are shamed in front of their gods!
The High Father is ashamed with this loss! It was a grave mistake to give to this task.
How dare you lose this contest! You made the clans lose face in front of our enemies! Wotan will never forgive you.
Mortis has prepared an eternal grave for you! There shall be no escape from his wrath. The shame you brought to the Hordes cannot be forgiven.
You will suffer from eternal flames for this! How dare you allow these puny creatures insult the Legions in such a way!

The gates are now all opened. It is time to prove your worth and claim all of the four precious artifacts in the name of your god! Some may be carried by your enemies and others may still be found in lairs.

You must now wrest the four items from the hands of your enemies or from their original locations if they are still there. These Items are: Doragon's Eye, the Soul Dagger, Uther's blood and the Holy Artifact.
Arrrgh! What a great job! Wotan has prepared a banquet for you and all of the Clans will rejoice and feast for a year!
Mortis is pleased with you! you will play a role of great importance in the horde's future plans. The other gods will now be forced to recognize our superiority.
You have done well! You are the true champion the Legions needed to represent them! We shall now laugh at our enemies' loss of face! Ha ha ha ha haaaa!
I will be your guide in this quest that the High Father has entrusted you. It is imperative that you fully realize the importance of this contest. The honor of the Empire will be in your hands.
Your first task will be to overtake the pass guardian to the east. She will summon forces to assault you until you face and defeat her. Do not waste too much time, our enemies are already moving.
I will guide you through this quest. Wotan is indeed putting a lot of trust in you, so, do not fail him! The honor of the clans will depend on the outcome of this contest.
First, you must defeat the guardian of the Eastern pass. Untill this is done, he will summon forces to assault you. Once you succeed in doing this, you will be told what lies ahead.
I have been sent to guide you through this quest. Let it be known that Mortis will not suffer you failing him on this important journey.
First, You will have to find and destroy the guardian blocking the western pass. Until then, she will send forces against you.
I will guide you in this important quest. The supremacy of the Legions is now in your hands.
First, take care of the pass guardian to the West. She will send her minions to test your abilities until this is done. Do not fail us!
In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.
